name: flitiq
description: Look up U.S. motor carriers, check CSA safety scores, verify insurance, and save carriers to your FlitIQ pipeline — all inside Claude. Requires a FlitIQ Pro or Team subscription.
long_description: FlitIQ is an FMCSA carrier intelligence tool used by brokers, shippers, and 3PLs to vet motor carriers before they book a load. This MCP plugin gives Claude access to the same data the FlitIQ web and iOS apps use: carrier identity, CSA BASIC scores, real insurance carrier names and policy detail (BIPD primary/excess, cargo, trust), recent inspections, recent crashes, and per-docket operating authority. Pro and Team subscribers can also save carriers to their pipeline directly from a Claude conversation. Per-carrier lookups only — no bulk export or list-all-carriers operation.

api_key.title: FlitIQ API Key
api_key.description: Generate a key at https://flitiq.com/settings/mcp. Requires a Pro or Team subscription.

tools.name: flitiq_search_carrier
tools.description: Search FMCSA carriers by name, DOT, or MC number.

tools.name: flitiq_get_safety
tools.description: CSA BASIC scores, OOS rates, safety rating.

tools.name: flitiq_get_insurance
tools.description: Active insurance policies — insurer, policy number, coverage, cancel date.

tools.name: flitiq_get_authority
tools.description: Common, contract, and broker authority status per docket.

tools.name: flitiq_save_carrier
tools.description: Save a carrier to the user's FlitIQ saved-carriers list.
